examples.arabic: أحمد مشي للمطعم الأول واداهم أربع شنط.
examples.english: Ahmed walked to the first restaurant and gave them four bags.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad meshi lel-matam el-awwal wa edahom arbaa shonat.

examples.arabic: سالت راجل في الشارع فين المطعم
examples.english: I asked a man in the street where the restaurant is.
examples.transliteration: saalt ragel fi el sharea fen el mataam

examples.english: I wanted to go to the new restaurant
examples.transliteration: kont ayez arouh el mataam el gedid

examples.arabic: احنا قاعدين في مطعم جنب الاهرامات
examples.english: We are sitting in a restaurant next to the pyramids.
examples.transliteration: ehna aadin fi matam ganb el ahramat

examples.arabic: لازم اشوف مطعم كبير ومفيش مشكلة في الفلوس
examples.english: I must see a big restaurant, and there is no problem with money.
examples.transliteration: Laazim ashouf maT'am kabeer wamafeesh moshkela fel felous.

examples.arabic: نروح سوا انا و اصحابي و نفطر في مطعم
examples.english: My friends and I will go together and have breakfast at a restaurant.
examples.transliteration: Narouh sawa ana w ashabi w neftar fi mat'am.
